name: Berlin.de
body: security.txt, one-year HSTS, nosniff, a content security policy, and a sitemap index. But the home page lists its English, French, Polish, and other versions in hreflang and skips German, the page itself.
lesson: List every language version in hreflang, including the page itself, and make each version link back.
summary: www.berlin.de scores 86 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 14 language alternate problems.

fix.title: 14 language alternate problems
fix.evidence: / has no self reference, /en/ has no self reference, /ar/ has no self reference and 11 more.
fix.fix: Each language version must list every version, itself included, and each must link back.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline', script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', script-src allows any host, object-src is not 'none', base-uri is not set.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

fix.title: 12 pages do not have exactly one h1
fix.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 3 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: 20 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
